description: This file is the main entry point of a Flutter-based Tic Tac Toe application. It defines the root widget, theme, and the main game screen, including game logic for handling moves, checking for wins/draws, and UI rendering with animations and styling.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up the MaterialApp with the custom theme and the home screen.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget that manages the game state, handles user interactions, determines game outcomes, and renders the game UI.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application, runs the TicTacToeApp widget.

methods.name: _buildTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns the ThemeData object with custom colors and styles for the app.

methods.name: _handleTap
methods.description: Handles user taps on the game grid, updates the game state if move is valid, and triggers animations.

methods.name: _resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state, clearing the board and resetting variables.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Checks the current board for win conditions or draw state and updates flags accordingly.

methods.name: _statusText
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the current game status, such as which player's turn or who won.

methods.name: _cellBorderColor
methods.description: Determines the border color of a cell, highlighting winning cells.

methods.name: _cellFillColor
methods.description: Determines the fill color of a cell, highlighting winning cells with a tint.

methods.name: _buildBoard
methods.description: Builds the 3x3 game board UI with interactive cells, animations, and styling.
